'''Parlay Thorp''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]]. A renowned expert on aging and rejuvenation, Thorp headed research at [[Obroa-skai/Legends|Obroa-skai's]] [[Aurora Medical Facility]], following stints at facilities of her own creation on [[Hijado]] and [[Enferm]], and having traveled to many other [[Planet/Legends|planets]] in the [[Tingel Arm/Legends|Tingel Arm]] on medical missions. Parlay Thorp was a one-time owner of the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], which she used for her missions, after the previous owner [[Quip Fargil]] donated the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] to the doctor. After spending several years with the ''Falcon'' on Hijado, the doctor sold the ship to [[Molpol's Traveling Circus]], where it went on to become collateral for at least a few wagers before coming into the hands of a young [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]].
